[[Dune Lizard]]s are large [[charmable]] reptiles found in most areas of the [[Crystal Desert]]. The Dune Lizards are able to survive the heat of the desert due to the frills on their head and back which vent the excess heat and their thickly calloused feet shield them from burning sand.

==Notes==
*Dune Lizards deal [[piercing damage]].
*[[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Tyria)''

==Trivia==
*A variation of the Dune Lizard, known as the [[Fern Lizard]], existed in the Beta Version of Guild Wars. It was found in [[the Northlands]] in [[pre-Searing Ascalon]]. It was decided the Lizard suited the [[Crystal Desert]] better so their location and name were changed.
*The Dune Lizard most resembles an agamid lizard, which are also found in desert areas.
